text: we got it solved. also [Image #1] good work on the uv mapping it was what was missing. the workspace for the uv could still use some real QoL upgrades like just a better way to get a larger workspace in general but it is working as it should now
resolution: Added an explicit UV Focus workspace because the previous width-only expansion still left dense meshes cramped. The labeled Focus/Return control doubles the atlas region to 960px and dedicates nearly the full panel height to UV editing, while keeping the live atlas and paint-variant state mounted, retaining compact Save access, refitting on mode changes, and resetting focus when the user leaves the model or Paint pane. The layout policy is locked by a focused unit test and the editor passes type-check plus a ReleaseFast build.
